title: Bind a live browser driver to the click adapter
goal: `nerv browser-click` and the tool click a control in a real open tab
acceptance: A real driver (Chrome DevTools protocol on a local debugging port) replaces the stub; origins come from an owner-set allowlist; the click still needs approval
Integration test against a local fixture page; credential fields and dialogs still refused
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-18 when the owner approved adding the live binding the owner check needs. Not a measurement.
